Release 2026-11-18 01:34

## Changes

### Features

- solid-query: sweep X-Revalidate keys in the single-flight consumer (#11394) (f41ac714d) by @ryansolid
- solid-query: built-in single-flight consumer via FLIGHT_DATA_SOURCE (#11326) (72f818550) by @ryansolid
- solid-query: rewrite the adapter onto Solid 2.0's native async model (#11308) (c809e09e8) by @ryansolid

### Fix

- solid-query: avoid held options reads during cache notifications (#12034) (6bab31bc3) by @niukanen1
- solid-query: follow Solid 2.0.0-rc.9 (#11543) (cb63f0707) by @ryansolid
- solid-query: don't re-create and refetch a removed query (#11360) (0e6ff548b) by @theRizwan
- solid-query: sweep X-Revalidate without a slice; reserve '*' for all (#11517) (09f266618) by @ryansolid
- solid-query: finish SSR when reading a disabled query (#11449) (fd3f1c946) by @mgarcia-improving
- solid-query: scope useMutation's cache subscription to the flight (#11325) (209f9f515) by @ryansolid
- solid-query: consume hydration data client-side via a provider-owned streaming channel (#11168) (67c817940) by @ryansolid
- release: remove unnecessary tag assignment for prerelease branches (4959c8739)
- solid-query: render resolved SSR value for deferred queries (#10957) (724706af2) by @brenelz
- solid-query-devtools: use onSettled for mount/unmount and flush() in tests (f74255f37) by @brenelz
- solid-query: make useMutation subscriber escape owned scope and fix Solid 2.0 test usages (f87aa3cd7) by @brenelz

### Refactor

- make query exports explicit (#12587) (b160291d1) by @TkDodo
- solid-query: move off sharedConfig onto Solid's public hydration API (#11751) (8a13b15c3) by @ryansolid
- solid-query: solid 2 reactivity compliance (#10316) (76fa68efb) by @2wheeh
- update to solid v2 for solid-query v6 (#10272) (4a27c6c18) by @brenelz

### Chore

- changeset: migrate pre state to the changesets v3 layout (#12614) (287f9e8d1) by @brenelz
- solid-query: require stable Solid 2.0 and @solidjs/vite-plugin 3.0 (#12613) (5e4469811) by @brenelz
- drop changeset merged in from main (5c87ba538) by @brenelz
- solid-query: satisfy main's oxlint rules in the v6 source and tests (e938b426f) by @brenelz
- vue-query/package.json: set 'parallelism: false' on 'test:lib' and 'test:types' so 'vue-demi-switch' does not race with vue example tasks (#12596) (2c1e767b9) by @sukvvon
- *: update pnpm to v12.18.0 and enable 'autoDedupe', 'lockfile.includeResolutionSettings' and exclusion pruning (#12582) (97e850240) by @sukvvon
- upgrade to solid v2 rc, rename vite-plugin-solid, move branch to rc (#11173) (7b04d6195) by @brenelz
- upgrade to solid v2 rc, rename vite-plugin-solid, move branch to rc (19c7623fe) by @brenelz
- upgrade to solid v2 beta 29 (#11133) (c6002fb57) by @brenelz
- upgrade to solid v2 beta 21 (#11092) (dafe80663) by @brenelz
- changeset: split solid-query into its own fixed group (#10983) (b970e5f8f) by @manudeli
- upgrade to solid v2 beta 15 (#10616) (18d1948c9) by @brenelz
- knip: remove redundant '@solidjs/web' from ignoreDependencies for solid-query packages (fa4e0a094) by @brenelz
- upgrade to solid v2 beta 7 (#10516) (b38c18d82) by @brenelz
- bump solid v2 beta 5 (#10392) (3ec54a15a) by @birkskyum
- upgrade to solid v2 beta 4 (#10307) (a31445713) by @brenelz


## Packages

- @tanstack/solid-query@6.0.0-rc.6
- @tanstack/solid-query-devtools@6.0.0-rc.6
- @tanstack/solid-query-persist-client@6.0.0-rc.6
